name: Islamic Wall Art
description: Explore original NoorShine Islamic wall art concepts for Pakistani homes, prayer spaces and meaningful gifting. Every calligraphy design remains a draft until its Arabic text and production artwork are manually verified.

name: Ayatul Kursi Wall Art
description: Discover proposed Ayatul Kursi wall art in contemporary geometric, circular and architectural compositions. Final Quranic text, dimensions, material specifications and prices require owner approval before publication.

name: Bismillah & Alhamdulillah Art
description: Browse elegant Bismillah and Alhamdulillah wall art concepts designed for entrances, dining areas and reflective interiors, with Arabic script held for scholarly and production verification.

name: Kalma & Shahada Calligraphy
description: View original Kalma and Shahada calligraphy layouts proposed in layered, arch and panoramic formats. Religious text and connected letterforms must be approved before any item becomes purchasable.

name: Quranic Surah Wall Art
description: A curated draft collection for selected Quranic surah wall art, planned for verified Arabic sources, careful typography and production-safe fabrication.

name: Allah & Muhammad ﷺ Calligraphy
description: Explore balanced paired and single-panel calligraphy concepts honouring the names Allah and Muhammad ﷺ, pending religious, artwork and manufacturing review.

name: Arabic Calligraphy
description: Modern Arabic calligraphy wall décor concepts shaped for refined Pakistani interiors. Script accuracy, meaning and fabrication bridges are verified before production.

name: Islamic Wall Clocks
description: Original Islamic wall clock concepts that combine readable timekeeping with respectful calligraphic composition. Clock movements and all religious artwork remain subject to testing and approval.

name: Modern Wall Clocks
description: Minimal and sculptural modern wall clock concepts for lounges, offices and bedrooms, proposed in acrylic, MDF and wood-inspired finishes.

name: Acrylic Wall Décor
description: Contemporary acrylic wall décor concepts using layered silhouettes, mirror-acrylic accents and clean geometric forms. Material thickness and mounting systems are not yet confirmed.

name: Wooden & MDF Wall Art
description: Warm wooden and MDF wall art concepts for modern Pakistani interiors, available as proposed natural, walnut, white and black finishes after production testing.

name: CNC Geometric Wall Panels
description: CNC geometric wall panel concepts inspired by Islamic pattern logic and modern architecture, with structural bridges and production tolerances to be validated before sale.

name: Personalized Name Wall Art
description: Personalized name wall art concepts for families, nurseries and gifting. Customers can preview approved non-religious text while every design receives a manual production review.

name: Custom Islamic Calligraphy
description: A request-based service for custom Islamic calligraphy. Quranic, Hadith and devotional text is never auto-approved and requires source, script and production verification.

name: Wedding & Housewarming Gifts
description: Thoughtful personalized wall décor concepts for weddings and new homes, with proposed names, dates and message layouts reviewed before fabrication.

name: Ramadan & Eid Décor
description: Seasonal Ramadan and Eid wall décor concepts created for welcoming spaces and family gatherings, with original designs and verified religious content only.
